From: Prio Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Anne Lee <anne.lee@latticeworks.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Service credit request for June 15 outage

Attached is the working calc (credit-calculation-v1.xlsx). Summary below:

Inputs:
- Monthly committed spend: $24,000
- Month (June 2026) total minutes: 30 days * 24 * 60 = 43,200 minutes
- Measured covered downtime: 72 minutes
- Effective impact factor (from telemetry + CS): 0.57 (57% of customer requests impacted)
- SLA uptime target: 99.95% (allowed downtime per month = 43,200 * 0.0005 = 21.6 minutes)

Calculation approach (per SLA Section 3.2):
1) Excess downtime = max(0, measured downtime - allowed downtime) = max(0, 72 - 21.6) = 50.4 minutes
2) Pro-rated credit base = (excess downtime / total minutes) * monthly_commit = (50.4 / 43,200) * $24,000 = $28.00 (rounded)
3) Impact adjustment = pro-rated credit base * effective impact factor = $28.00 * 0.57 = $15.96
4) Cap check: per contract, credit cannot exceed 25% of monthly commit = 0.25 * $24,000 = $6,000 — not applicable here.

Proposed credit to apply: $15.96 (round up to $16.00 for invoicing simplicity).

Notes: the calculation follows our standard SLA formula but uses the impact factor to reflect partial degradations (fallbacks). Open to alternate interpretations if legal requires different rounding.

Prio
Site Reliability Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: credit-calculation-v1.xlsx

Option B: issue an immediate refund/adjustment outside of invoicing (requires additional AR workflow; target time +7 business days).

I authorize Option A. Anne — if that works, Karthik can confirm and we'll docket the credit to be applied to July's billing run (first week of July). I'll attach a signed approval scan.

Seán Gallagher
